result.title: TSFM Meets LLM: Context as Covariates
result.summary: Textual information is ubiquitous in real-world time series datasets, appearing as news, reports, and annotations that hold key predictive signals not deducible from numerical history alone. Large Language Models (LLMs) interpret text but lack numerical precision, while Time Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) are quantitatively accurate but cannot reason about the effects of text. Moreover, the lack of large-scale paired multimodal datasets limits progress in bridging this gap. In this work, we address this challenge by providing a scalable approach for generating realistic multimodal datasets by annotating real-world time series with LLMs. Building on this, we propose Context as Covariates (CoCo), a forecasting framework in which an LLM distills its textual reasoning into numerically grounded forecast and confidence covariates that guide a TSFM backbone, thereby exploiting the strengths of both LLMs and TSFMs. We align the two models in stages, first fine-tuning the LLM via Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with a reward tied to covariate-induced improvement in forecasting performance, and then fine-tuning the TSFM on covariates generated by the aligned LLM. Our experiments show that models trained on our synthetic multimodal corpus generalize to real benchmarks spanning finance, economics, weather, traffic, and security. Notably, CoCo with Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 as the LLM and Chronos2 as the TSFM achieves up to 12% MAE improvement over state-of-the-art TSFMs and LLM forecasters, such as GPT-4o. Code, checkpoints, and the evaluation datasets are publicly available.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 CoCo 框架：用 LLM 将文本信息中的推理蒸馏为带数值的预测与置信度「协变量」，用以引导 TSFM 主干做时序预测；并先用 GRPO 以下游预测增益为奖励对齐 LLM，再在生成协变量上微调 TSFM，同时给出由 LLM 标注真实时序构造多模态语料的方案。
AI.relevance_reason: 把开放式文本推理压缩成少量数值协变量、并以「下游任务收益」作 RL 奖励做两阶段监督，可能为 latent 推理状态的信息保真与贡献分配、以及推理内容是否真被主干使用提供可供核查的线索；与时序预测主线本身无直接视觉关联。
